source_values: GMRT Grid (Marine Geoscience Data System, Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory), netCDF subsets via gmrt.org GridServer, fetched 2026-10-16
validation: Spot values cross-checked against the NIWA NZ Region Bathymetry 250 m model (GNS Science ImageServer identify endpoint): Challenger Plateau NIWA -973 m, Campbell Plateau -501 m, Cook Strait -96 m, Aoraki 3333 m (identify, 250 m grid)
citation_gmrt: Ryan, W.B.F. et al. (2009) Global Multi-Resolution Topography synthesis. Geochem. Geophys. Geosyst. 10, Q03014
citation_niwa: Mitchell, J.S.; Mackay, K.A.; Neil, H.L.; Mackay, E.J.; Pallentin, A.; Notman, P. (2012) New Zealand Region Bathymetry, 1:4,000,000, 2nd Edition. NIWA Chart, Miscellaneous Series No. 92
crs: EPSG:3851 (NZGD2000 / NZCS2000, Lambert Conformal Conic, metres)

heightmap_normalization.note: recover metres = png/65535*15000-11000; NoData cells are set to the floor value in the PNG and black in the preview

source_grid: GMRT low-resolution subsets for the full extent: 818 x 528 cells over lon 154.97..192.09, lat -58.00..-13.92 (about 0.054 deg lat x 0.070 deg lon, roughly 6 km). The game grid upscales this to 1,847 m pixels; shapes and plateau depths are true, sharp peaks are smoothed.
known_limits: Aoraki / Mt Cook samples 1,778 m in this overview grid vs 3,333 m in NIWA's native 250 m model - peak smoothing from the coarse source, not an error.
Cook Strait samples +38 m (land-bridged) at this resolution; the strait is narrower than the source cells.

A finer GMRT core pass over the New Zealand heartland was attempted 2026-10-16 and the GMRT server returned 504 timeouts; retry later, or build the detail grid from NIWA small-area exports once Han picks the first dungeon zone.
NoData (18.7% of the rectangle) is the corners of the NZCS rectangle outside the fetched lon/lat box - ocean far from the continent, not missing continent data.
